messages:
Nina Patel: Hey folks — I moved from California to Oregon on 2024-06-15 and updated my address in Workday but my last two paystubs still show CA state withholding. Will my W-2 show CA or OR for the year, and do I need to do anything to get a refund for CA withholding?
Jamal (People Ops): @Nina thanks for flagging. Did you change your state tax filing status and state in Workday before the 6/15 payroll cutoff? If it happened after the payroll run it might not have taken effect until next cycle.
Nina Patel: I updated my home address and state election on 2024-06-18 (oops, after the mid-month cutoff). I included my new OR driver's license scan in the update.
Erin (Tax Ops): Since the move date is mid-year, W-2 state boxes can include multiple states. For Redwood, payroll withholds state tax based on residence/state on file at payroll processing time and also job site rules. If you were a CA resident for part of the year and OR resident for the rest, the W-2 may show CA in Box 15-17 with CA wages/tax and OR separately if we processed OR withholding.
Nina Patel: I never worked physically in CA after 6/15, I was remote from OR starting 6/16. Is there a simple way to get CA withholding reversed for paychecks processed after 6/15?
Sam (Payroll Specialist): Short answer: we can request an adjustment, but it depends on whether the payroll run already withheld CA tax. If yes, we can file an employer adjustment to recalculate YTD state withholding and issue a correction or refund. Please attach copies of your lease or carrier change notice to support the effective move date.
Payroll Bot: [system] Payroll inquiry logged: TAX-90312. Please attach documentation within 7 days to avoid processing delays.
Erin (Tax Ops): Two options: 1) If CA withholding was erroneous for pay periods after 6/15 we can process a payroll adjustment and refund via next payrun. 2) Alternatively, you can claim a refund from CA Franchise Tax Board at year-end when you file your CA part-year return. We prefer option 1 to avoid you waiting.
Jamal (People Ops): Action items @Nina: upload move docs to the HR ticket, confirm last physical workday in CA, and confirm if you want us to push for a payroll adjustment or handle it at tax filing.
Nina Patel: I'll upload my OR lease start date (2024-06-16) and my updated license tonight. Please push for an adjustment if possible  I'm happy to provide anything else.
Sam (Payroll Specialist): Got it. I'll queue a YTD recalculation once docs are attached. Typical turnaround is 2 payroll cycles; we'll notify you in TAX-90312.
Erin (Tax Ops): Note: if CA tax was withheld by personal elections (e.g., you had a CA state form on file) we might need you to sign an employee authorization for reallocation. I'll add details to the ticket.
Nina Patel: Thanks all. Appreciate the quick help.
Jamal (People Ops): Thanks @Nina — ping if you don't see an update in 5 business days. :thumbsup:
Payroll Bot: [system] Ticket TAX-90312 status: awaiting documentation.
